sn56.56:1.1: yogo karanīyo ti || || Seyyathāpi bhikkhave mahāpathavī parikkhayam pariyādānaṃ gaccheyya ṭhapetvā sattakolaṭṭhimattiyo guḷikā || || Taṃ kim maññatha bhikkhave || katamaṃ nu kho bahutaraṃ yaṃ vā mahāpaṭhaviyā parikkhīṇam pariyādinnam yā vā sattakolaṭṭhimattiyo guḷikā avasiṭṭhā ti || || Etad eva bhante bahutaram mahāpathaviyā yad idam parikkhīnam pariyādinnam || appamattikā sattakolaṭṭhimattiyo guḷikā avasiṭṭhā saṅkham pi na upenti || pe || kalabhāgam pi na upenti mahāpathaviyā parikkhīnam pariyādinnam upanidhāya sattakolaṭṭhimattiyo guḷikā avasiṭṭhā ti || || 4--5. Evam eva kho bhikkhave ariyasavakassa || so yeva peyyālo ||
